title: Yoshimura Shougi
overview:
A Shogi Player Is Born.

- "Yoshimura Shogi" is a cut above "Eisei Meijin" - a new shogi game awaits you.
- Just go through the setup screens in order and start a game right away.
- The CPU even reads ahead while the player is thinking, truly recreating the feel of playing against a real shogi player.

棋士、誕生。

●"永世名人"とはひと味もふた味も違う"吉村将棋"新しい将棋ゲームにあなたは会える。
●画面を順番に設定していくだけで、すぐに対局スタート。
●プレイヤーの考慮中にCPUが予測読みまでおこない、まさに、本物の棋士との対局感覚を実現。
